name: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
department: Department of Social Security & Welfare, Jharkhand
description: Universal pension scheme providing monthly financial assistance to vulnerable citizens of Jharkhand, including the elderly, widows, and disabled persons.

not_receiving_other_pension.description: Must not be receiving pension from any other government scheme

benefits.description: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to beneficiary's bank account (DBT).

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate
documents_required.condition: If applying under SC/ST for early age eligibility

offline_steps: Collect the form from your Block/Circle office or Panchayat
Fill in personal and bank details and attach required documents
Submit to Block Development Officer (BDO) or Circle Officer (CO)

name: Abua Awas Yojana
department: Department of Rural Development, Jharkhand
description: Jharkhand state housing scheme providing financial assistance to build 3-room pucca houses for homeless and kutcha-house-dwelling families.

benefits.description: ₹2 Lakh in 4 installments for construction of a 3-room pucca house.

offline_steps: Applications collected at Gram Sabha or 'Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar' outreach camps
Verification done by Block Development Officer
Funds released in 4 installments upon construction milestones

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: Central government scheme to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to houseless families and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas.

bpl_card.description: BPL / SECC list families get priority

benefits.description: ₹1.30 Lakh for plain areas, ₹1.50 Lakh for hilly/NE states; plus 90 days MGNREGA unskilled wage support.

offline_steps: Beneficiaries are selected from SECC 2011 data by Gram Sabha
Verification done at Block office and District office
Funds released via PFMS directly to bank account

name: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana
department: Department of Agriculture, Jharkhand
description: Provides relief to small and marginal KCC loan holders by waiving agricultural loans up to ₹2 Lakh.

benefits.description: Waiver of outstanding KCC agricultural loan up to ₹2,00,000 per farmer.

offline_steps: Beneficiaries identified by banks from SECC data
e-KYC at Pragya Kendra (CSC) for Rs. 1 nominal fee

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of India
description: Central government income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three installments to small and marginal farmer families.

benefits.description: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly via DBT to farmer's bank account.

offline_steps: Register through local Patwari / Revenue officer or CSC
Or self-register at pmkisan.gov.in portal

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (MMKAY)
department: Department of Agriculture, Jharkhand
description: Jharkhand state scheme providing input subsidy to small and marginal farmers at the beginning of Kharif season for seeds, fertilizers, and farm machinery.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 per acre per year, maximum ₹25,000 per family for up to 5 acres.

offline_steps: Register at nearest Pragya Kendra (CSC) or Block Agriculture Office
Funds credited directly to bank account before Kharif season

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of India
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

benefits.description: Farmer pays only 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops. Government pays the rest. Full sum insured paid on total crop loss.

offline_steps: Enroll through your bank (mandatory for loan-taking farmers)
Non-loan farmers can enroll online at pmfby.gov.in or through CSC

name: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Jharkhand
description: Financial assistance scheme to promote girls' education, prevent child marriage, and empower adolescent girls in Jharkhand through milestone-based scholarships.

benefits.description: Class 8/9: ₹2,500; Class 10/11/12: ₹5,000; On turning 18-19 (unmarried): one-time ₹20,000. Total potential: ₹40,000.

offline_steps: Forms available at Anganwadi centres or the school
Submit completed form with documents to school headmaster or Anganwadi Sevika

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran (MMKSY)
department: Department of Rural Development, Jharkhand
description: Empowers rural women farmers through SHG (Self Help Group) network, providing agriculture inputs, training, and market linkage support.

shg_member.description: Priority if member of Sakhi Mandal / SHG

benefits.description: Agriculture inputs, Seeds + fertilizers, free training; potential ₹50,000 grant for farm development through JSLPS.

offline_steps: Contact your local Sakhi Mandal or JSLPS block coordinator
Apply through the Jeevika or JSLPS program officer at block level

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive for partial wage compensation during pregnancy and nursing, and encouraging women to follow best practices.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 in 3 installments: ₹1,000 on early ANC registration, ₹2,000 after 6-month ANC check, ₹2,000 after child birth registration and first vaccination.

offline_steps: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC)
Submit form with documents to AWC Sevika / Health Sub-centre

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Savings scheme for the girl child ensuring financial security. Parents/guardians can open an account in the name of a girl child below 10 years.

benefits.description: Current interest rate 8.2% p.a. Minimum ₹250/yr deposit. Maturity at 21 years; partial withdrawal at 18 for education/marriage.

offline_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized bank branch (SBI, PNB, etc.)
Fill SSY account opening form
Deposit minimum ₹250 to activate the account

name: Mukhyamantri Rojgar Srijan Yojana (CMEGP)
department: Department of Welfare, Jharkhand
description: Provides subsidized bank loans to youth from marginalized communities to start their own businesses / micro enterprises in Jharkhand.

benefits.description: Loan up to ₹25 Lakh with 40% subsidy (max ₹5 lakh). No guarantor for loans up to ₹50,000.

offline_steps: Submit application at District Welfare Office / ITDA / Minority Finance Corporation
Bank reviews and sanctions the loan with subsidy

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (MGNREGS)
name_hindi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do such work.

benefits.description: ₹257/day wage (Jharkhand rate) for 100 days guaranteed work. Women get 1/3 reservation.

offline_steps: Get/verify your Job Card from Gram Panchayat
Submit written application for work at Gram Panchayat office
Work must be provided within 15 days of application

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
description: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 trades) with free skill training, toolkits worth ₹15,000, and collateral-free loans at concessional rates.

benefits.description: ₹15,000 toolkit; Skill training with ₹500/day stipend; Collateral-free loan: ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1), ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) at 5% subsidized interest.

offline_steps: Register at nearest CSC (Pragya Kendra) with Aadhaar and mobile
Complete skill training set by NSDC
Apply for toolkit grant and loan after training

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
name_hindi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति छात्रों के लिए प्री-मेट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
department: Department of Welfare, Jharkhand / Ministry of Social Justice
description: Scholarship to SC/ST students studying in Classes 9 and 10 to prevent dropout and encourage continuation of education.

benefits.description: ₹3,500/year for day scholars; ₹7,000/year for hostel students. In addition, book grants and maintenance allowance.

offline_steps: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Institute verifies the application
Amount disbursed directly to student's account

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
department: Ministry of Social Justice / Tribal Affairs, Government of India
description: Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.

benefits.description: Maintenance allowance + compulsory fees covered. For SC: family income below ₹2.5 lakh; For ST: ₹2.5 lakh; For OBC: ₹1 lakh.

offline_steps: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) before the deadline
College/institution verifies and forwards application

name: Mukhyamantri Medha Chatravriti Yojana
department: Department of School Education & Literacy, Jharkhand
description: Merit-based scholarship for meritorious students of Class 9 studying in government schools of Jharkhand who passed Class 8 with top scores.

benefits.description: ₹12,000/year for students who qualify the state-level merit exam.

offline_steps: Selected through a state-level competitive exam (MMCY Exam)
Application through school headmaster
Scholarship paid directly to student's account

name: Ayushman Bharat – Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hindi: आयुष्मान भारत – प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
department: National Health Authority, Government of India
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled hospitals.

bpl_card.description: BPL/SECC 2011 listed families are primary beneficiaries

benefits.description: ₹5 Lakh cashless health coverage per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals. Covers 1,929+ procedures.

offline_steps: Check eligibility at Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any empanelled hospital
Or check online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar / Ration Card
No enrollment needed — auto-enrolled if in SECC 2011 list

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh term cover for death due to any cause at just ₹436 per year premium.

bank_account.description: Must have savings bank account linked to Aadhaar

benefits.description: ₹2,00,000 life cover for death due to any cause. Premium: ₹436/year (auto-deducted from bank account).

offline_steps: Fill PMJJBY enrollment form at your bank branch
Or enroll through net banking / mobile banking of your bank

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage for accidental death and disability at a premium of just ₹20/year.

benefits.description: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability. Premium: ₹20/year.

offline_steps: Fill PMSBY enrollment form at your bank branch
Or enroll through net banking / mobile banking

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare / NABARD
description: Credit card for farmers providing flexible revolving credit for agricultural inputs, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.

benefits.description: Credit limit up to ₹3 Lakh at 7% interest (4% effective with interest subvention for timely repayment). Includes crop + personal accident insurance.

offline_steps: Apply at your nearest cooperative bank, SBI, or regional rural bank
PM Kisan beneficiaries can apply online via PM Kisan portal

name: Mukhyamantri Divyang Pension Yojana
department: Department of Social Welfare, Jharkhand
description: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities in Jharkhand who have 40% or more disability and are below 60 years of age.

benefits.description: ₹1,000 per month. Persons with 80%+ disability get ₹1,500/month.

offline_steps: Submit application at Block office or Circle office
Attach disability certificate from authorized medical authority
Verified by district social welfare officer

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
description: Provides affordable housing to urban poor including slum dwellers, EWS, LIG, and MIG categories through Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).

women_head.description: EWS/LIG houses must be in name of woman or co-ownership

bpl_card.description: BPL families get in-situ slum redevelopment priority

benefits.description: EWS/LIG: Subsidy of 6.5% on loan up to ₹6L (max ₹2.67L subsidy). MIG-I: 4% on ₹9L. MIG-II: 3% on ₹12L.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card of all adult family members
Affidavit of no pucca house ownership in India

offline_steps: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or at city/municipal office
For CLSS: apply through Housing Finance Companies or banks
For slum redevelopment: apply through Urban Local Body (Municipality)

name: Mukhyamantri Sukhad Rahat Yojana (Widow Relief)
department: Department of Agriculture, Jharkhand
description: Relief assistance to drought-affected farm families in Jharkhand providing immediate income support for food and agricultural recovery.

benefits.description: ₹3,500 immediate relief per affected farm family via DBT during declared drought periods.

offline_steps: Registration done automatically by government based on Gram Sabha surveys
Verify your name in the beneficiary list at block/panchayat office
Amount directly transferred to bank account
